content.short: Bitcoin/stablecoin wallet, APIs, payouts and virtual cards.
content.description: Bitnob, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Nigeria, is a crypto-powered financial platform built for consumers, businesses, and developers across Africa and beyond. It combines Bitcoin, the Lightning Network, and stablecoins such as USDT and USDC with local fiat rails to enable cross-border payments, remittances, savings, payouts, and virtual dollar cards. Through its consumer app and enterprise API, Bitnob offers multi-currency wallets, wallet-as-a-service infrastructure, and on/off-ramps that let businesses move money globally and settle locally. By bridging stablecoins across networks including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Solana with Bitcoin and fiat, Bitnob positions itself as a practical bridge between crypto liquidity and everyday African money movement.
